regression.method: Real HTTP, oidc-provider middleware, DCR, path-aware shared browser cookies, real in-memory provider adapter writes and PKCE token exchange; no mock of the proposed guard.

beforeFix.limit: Original terminal result retained; no pre-fix log file was created. Initial opaque-token fixture errors were corrected and excluded from this proof.

assertions: Mismatch returns HTTP400 without another client disclosure or redirect
No grant/code writes and neither interaction completed by mismatched request

fix: Compare interaction.uid to ctx.params.uid immediately after interactionDetails in both routes, before client details, approval or cancellation.
